name: io.github.adwarp-dev/adwarp
title: Adwarp
description: Open-source ad agent for LinkedIn Ads and Google Ads. Drafts campaigns, audiences and reports.

packageArguments.description: Starts the MCP server on stdio

environmentVariables.name: ADWARP_LINKEDIN_CLIENT_ID
environmentVariables.description: LinkedIn app Client ID. Leave unset to use ~/.adwarp from adwarp auth login

environmentVariables.name: ADWARP_LINKEDIN_CLIENT_SECRET
environmentVariables.description: LinkedIn app Client Secret. Leave unset to use ~/.adwarp

environmentVariables.name: ADWARP_LINKEDIN_REFRESH_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: Refresh token from adwarp auth login. Leave unset to use ~/.adwarp

environmentVariables.name: ADWARP_LINKEDIN_DEFAULT_ACCOUNT_ID
environmentVariables.description: LinkedIn ad account used when a call omits one

headers.name: X-Adwarp-Linkedin-Refresh-Token
headers.description: Refresh token from adwarp auth login

headers.name: X-Adwarp-Linkedin-Account-Id
headers.description: LinkedIn ad account used when a call omits one
